2. This appeal is preferred by the claimant assailing the Judgment and award dated 18.02.2020 passed in MVC No.1055/2017 on the file of the Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XIII,
and IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Vijayapura, (for short 'the Tribunal'), awarding compensation to the claimant.
3.

entities.text:
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.XIII,
and IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Vijayapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For the sake of convenience, the parties will be referred to as per their ranking before the Tribunal.

4. Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel for the appellant, it is forthcoming from the NC: 2026:KHC-K:858 HC-KAR finding recorded by the Tribunal that, the claimant sustained injury on account of the accident alleged to have been occurred on 22.09.2017.

On careful consideration of the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal and it is also to be noted that, the treating Doctor has not been examined by the claimant as to prove the disability.
In that view of the matter, taking into consideration the award of compensation made by the Tribunal is on the higher side, which does not call for interference in this appeal.

5. It is also to be pertinent to mention here that, the Tribunal has awarded interest at the rate of 9%,
however, since the appeal is preferred by the claimant for seeking enhancement, no interference is called for in this appeal.
